context.title: Palo Alto Professional Firefighters: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Palo Alto — Measure J (Transactions and Use Tax)

positions.statement: Joseph Penko (President Palo Alto Professional Firefighters) signed the argument in favor of Palo Alto Measure J and the rebuttal to the argument against Palo Alto Measure J in the Santa Clara County Voter Information Guide.
